"A guide to animal welfare for anyone with a companion animal"
What you should know comes first

Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for travelers

If you are bringing a pet through Aurelia Skyways, keep your papers, carrier details, and feeding notes together before you reach the counter. The desk checks the basics fast, and that helps cut stress for you and for the animal. Clear records also make it easier to move from booking to handoff without a scramble.

Start by making sure the carrier is safe, clean, and easy to open when needed. The animal should have room to stand, turn, and settle without being squeezed. Add a familiar blanket or toy if it helps the pet stay calm, but keep the inside tidy and simple. Do not pack loose items that can shift around or block airflow.

Food and water plans matter too. Keep meals light before travel unless your vet says otherwise. Bring what the pet needs for the trip and label anything that must stay with the carrier. If your animal takes medicine, keep it in the same pouch as the travel papers so it is easy to reach during checks. Quick access saves time and avoids mistakes.

When you arrive at the skyport, tell the desk if your pet is anxious, elderly, recovering, or sensitive to noise. That kind of note helps staff choose the best handling path. If the animal has special care needs, say so early. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works from booking through pickup, so early notice gives the team room to prepare.

Watch the pet often while you wait. If there are signs of stress, heavy panting, or restlessness, speak up right away. Calm handling is the goal, and small problems are easier to fix before boarding begins. Stay close to the carrier and keep your voice low.

If you are picking up a pet after arrival, check the carrier, the condition of the animal, and any travel notes before you leave the area. Report anything unusual right away so the record stays clean and the next step is easier.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at your nearest Aurelia Skyways skyport.
